tested.scope: CPU; includes existing NativePolicy.predict DDIM loop with independent toy denoiser, prefix/gap noise parity, admission/selected best/train-only projection, metric threshold and failure preservation; no CUDA model acceptance

interpretation: All ten completed epochs, 137 episode updates per epoch per role. Training phase includes loader/encoding/backprop/optimizer/writes/resource entry; it is not pure GPU compute.
Metrics phase includes val6+train2 full-history encoding, feature reads, serial DDIM and aggregation. Its 28.62%/29.84% share does not establish the DDIM-only fraction.

A epoch6 and B epoch7 overlap. Their 187.66/188.31s consumer waits happen at prefetch future.result before lease entry. Slow rows spend nearly all load time in CPU clone touching mmap pages. Observed consumer wait dominates these stalls.
Budget, loader clone and consumer waits overlap; never add them to produce total wall time. Normal producer budget waits across many rows differ from the exceptional long clone waits.

read_bytes is the per-process Linux I/O counter, including overlapping prefetch and OS cache effects. The A+B sum is not an independently measured physical-disk total or unique bytes; shared-page/device attribution and CPU/disk root cause remain unresolved.

Resource samples during the central slow window show GPU median1%, RAM>=22.92GiB, VRAM>=9440MiB and no recorded pauses/pacing/external GPU processes. There is no per-row exact lease timer; do not claim one.
Initial/final correction metrics and checkpoint work are separate from per-epoch metrics totals. No new validation/test payload or evaluation was performed for this CPU audit.

Candidate retains every 60Hz history update, teacher-forced actual past commands, native5Hz skipped noise draws and legal commit12 masks. It only groups consecutive independent offline anchor conditions. No optimizer budget or default trainer/cycle path changed.

CPU exact-noise parity does not establish CUDA denoiser numerical parity. Fixed M1/M8/M32 must pass raw and bounded final-target max_abs<=2e-5 rad; per-profile metric differences and actual CUDA timings are recorded before any adoption.
Gate timing order is serial then M1/M8/M32; warm kernels/cache and concurrent work affect timing. Standalone inference gate is not a completed production-throughput improvement.
Earlier one-epoch paired-I/O arm was slower and remains unadopted. That result does not settle a future explicitly registered multi-epoch larger-pool comparison; this review starts no paired run.

gate.default_train_cohort: First training original and first latest correction, deduplicated; explicit --identity may select 1..4 train episodes only
gate.completed_checkpoint: Exact best.pt SHA bound to finished.json; arbitrary last.pt fallback forbidden. --root and --frozen-source-root may name another completed source or selected round.
gate.check_only: Add --check-only and use a different fresh --output. CPU admission still hashes selected checkpoint/shards and copies only selected train numeric tensors; avoid concurrent I/O-sensitive work.
gate.bounded: Fixed cohort and profiles; max600s checked between calls, active session resource lease/deadline respected. Persistent owner should impose external deadline for hung CUDA calls. Existing output refuses overwrite; no automatic retry.
